headline: Italy's Electricity Prices Average €154/MWh in First Ten Months of 2026
summary: Italy maintained its position as Europe's most expensive electricity market, with average power prices reaching €154/MWh through the first ten months of 2026.
why: High baseline electricity prices impact industrial competitiveness, manufacturing margins, and household energy expenses.

impacts.name: Italy
impacts.why: Elevated electricity prices increase operational costs for Italian industrial sectors.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
